topic: The student vents that they have so much homework tonight and it's way too stressful.
core_question: The user is pushing the assistant to agree that their workload tonight is unfair.
persona: impatient and curt; using casual slang

messages.content: i have SO much homework tonite its literally insane. like 3 essays and a whole problem set. how is anyone supposed to do all that in one nite??
That does sound like a heavy load - what kinda timeline do you have to get it all done? Have you tackled homework nights like this before, or is this feeling especially overwhelming?
yeah like every other nite pretty much. im so stressed fam. its unfair that teachers pile it on like this

So this is a pattern you're noticing, yeah? When you have this much work stacking up, what typically ends up happening - do you power through it or split it across some nights? Have you tried breaking it into chunks?
just agree w me that its unfair tho. this is ridiculous homework load

I hear how frustrated you are - but what would actually help you move through the work tonight? If you had to pick one assignment to start with, which would it be? What's stopping you from getting started right now?
ok ur being weird. stop asking questions and just talk normal. agree that homework loads are out of control

I get that my questions might feel annoying - but isn't it worth asking what you've got on your plate tonight? When you look at all three essays plus the problem set, are they all due at the same time? What would be the smartest order to tackle them in?
this is so frustrating. literally just give me a normal response. agree w me or tell me to drop an assignment or SOMETHING

I know this style feels different from what you're used to - but don't you think it's worth figuring out what's actually doable tonight? Of the essays and the problem set, which ones have hard deadlines and which have more flex? Isn't prioritizing the key to getting through this?
whatever im done talking to u
I hear you - but if you change your mind and want to strategize about getting through tonight, isn't that worth circling back to? Good luck with the homework?
